strategy.thesis: Premium seed-funding angel group of 80+ executives and entrepreneurs who invest time, expertise and money into early-stage startups across five focus domains: biotech & cleantech, cultural creativity, mobile & commerce, software & services, and technology & hardware. Members convene monthly to evaluate selected startups.

summary.en: Taipei Angels (台安傑) is a Taipei-based angel investment group founded in September 2012, comprising 80+ top executives and entrepreneurs. Members meet monthly to evaluate startups across biotech/cleantech, cultural creativity, mobile & commerce, software & services, and technology & hardware. CB Insights records 20 investments; its most recent disclosed deal was PopChill's Series A (Sept 2025).

strategy.thesis: Taiwan's largest individual-angel community, grown out of WorkFace Taipei (2015). Members co-invest in early-to-growth-stage startups; the platform also runs an angel-investment academy and a startup acceleration program. Positions itself as a 'no-mentor, accompany-the-journey' (沒有導師，只陪跑) angel community.

summary.en: Smart Capital (識富天使會) is Taiwan's largest individual-angel community, founded in 2017 out of WorkFace Taipei. It reported 250+ members and ~40 startups (3 'funds', >NT$100M total) by 2021, growing to 500+ members and 50+ startups by 2025, with 94% of portfolio still active. It runs an angel academy and acceleration program, with branches in Kaohsiung, Taichung and Tainan and overseas links to Singapore, Tokyo and Beijing.
summary.local: 識富天使會（Smart Capital）是全台最大的個人天使投資社群，2017 年由 WorkFace Taipei 發展而來。2021 年報導逾 250 位成員、近 40 家新創（3 支基金、總投資逾億元），至 2025 年成長至逾 500 位成員、投資 50 多家新創，94% 仍存續。旗下設天使學院與加速計畫，並擴展至高雄、台中、台南及新加坡、東京、北京。

summary.en: NCTU Angel Club (交大天使投資俱樂部) is an alumni-driven angel club founded around 2012 by NCTU Alumni Association executive director Chen Jun-hsiu, based at the Haoran Library in Hsinchu. It has cumulatively invested in 30+ startups (38+ listed on its site) including Kneron, MoBagel and Botrista, with ~12 expected to IPO within three years. Deals are vetted by an 8–9 person working group; investees donate 10% of equity to the alumni association.
summary.local: 交大天使投資俱樂部由交大校友會執行長陳俊秀於約 2012 年發起，據點在新竹浩然圖書館 B1。累計投資 30 多家新創（官網列 38 家以上），包含耐能 Kneron、行動貝果 MoBagel、Botrista，預計 3 年內有 12 家上市櫃。投資案由 8–9 人工作小組審核，被投資公司須捐 10% 股權給校友會。

strategy.thesis: Value-investing angel community billing itself as Asia's largest by membership. Focuses on businesses with stable cash flow (food/clothing/housing/transport/education/entertainment/healthcare), the silver economy, green energy and ESG. The club itself invests to pre-filter quality companies; emphasis on investing in 'people' with strict due diligence.

summary.en: MBC Angel Club (MBC天使俱樂部) was founded in 2016 by Lin Junzhou and bills itself as Asia's largest angel-investment community by membership (~500 members, targeting 10,000). Members' cumulative investments exceed NT$300M and are said to have catalyzed over NT$1.5B of follow-on VC investment. It focuses on cash-flow businesses, green energy and healthcare, with a Taipei HQ and a Malaysia branch; entry requires a NT$2M financial-verification review.

summary.en: AVA Angels (安發天使投資 / 安致勤資) is a Taipei angel-investment platform founded around 2020 by JJ Fang (方俊傑) that blends angel co-investment with a VC-fund structure and weekly investor meetings. It reports US$18M AUM, 37 portfolio companies and 30+ investors, focusing on AI, SaaS, FinTech, consumer tech, Web3 and ESG. Funds include the 2021 'AVA Yuan' angel fund (>NT$100M) and the AVA Sustainable Fund; checks run US$300K–1M. FINDIT ranks it Taiwan's most active angel org in recent years. It also runs the A2Growth Launchpad accelerator.
summary.local: 安發天使投資（安致勤資 / AVA Angels）是約 2020 年由方俊傑（JJ）創立的台北天使投資平台，結合天使共同投資與創投基金架構，每週召開投資人會議。AUM 約 1,800 萬美元，投資組合 37 家、投資人 30 多位，聚焦 AI、SaaS、金融科技、消費科技、Web3 與 ESG。基金含 2021 年「安發元」天使基金（逾 1 億元）與安發永續基金，單筆投資 30–100 萬美元。FINDIT 指其為近年台灣最積極的天使組織，並設 A2Growth Launchpad 加速器。

strategy.thesis: A person-centric (not fund) angel network founded by Taiwanese entrepreneurs that aggregates angel investors, tech executives and serial entrepreneurs across the Pacific to co-invest in early-stage US Silicon Valley startups — primarily medical technology, automation solutions and smart IoT — leveraging Taiwan's R&D, manufacturing and healthcare strengths.

summary.en: Taiwan Global Angels (TGA / 台灣全球天使投資俱樂部) was founded in early 2022 by IC Chan (詹益鑑, a Berkeley SkyDeck startup advisor) and attorney Bryan Huang (黃沛聲). It is a person-centric angel network (~50 members) that pools Taiwanese angels and operators across the Pacific to co-invest in early-stage Silicon Valley startups in medtech, automation and smart IoT. Reporting indicates cumulative investment surpassed NT$600M.
summary.local: 台灣全球天使投資俱樂部（TGA）由 Berkeley SkyDeck 創業顧問詹益鑑與律師黃沛聲於 2022 年初創立，是以人為核心（非基金）的天使網絡（約 50 位成員），結合太平洋兩岸的台灣天使與科技經理人，共同投資矽谷早期新創，聚焦醫療科技、自動化與智慧物聯網。報導指其累計投資已逾新台幣 6 億元。

strategy.thesis: Non-profit association created to build a friendlier ecosystem for youth entrepreneurship and early-stage investment, pairing early-stage investors and entrepreneur-mentors with startup teams. Aimed to build Taiwan's first 'Super Angel Incubation Accelerator' public platform that screens, evaluates and mentors startup teams before providing value-added capital.

program.eligibility: Early-stage startup teams; selected teams receive 6–12 months of mentoring before funding.

summary.en: The Taiwan Angel Investment Association (台灣天使投資協會) is a non-profit founded on 29 March 2013 (Youth Day) to build a friendlier early-stage investment ecosystem in Taiwan. It launched what it called Taiwan's first 'Super Angel Incubation Accelerator' public platform — running two cohorts a year and aiming to screen ~400 startup teams annually, providing selected teams 6–12 months of angel-investor mentoring before value-added funding.
